stories.title: White House blocks Politico from Air Force One as press-access fight escalates
stories.summary: The White House refused to let Politico join the press pool aboard Air Force One on Monday, days after a judge ordered the administration to restore access for outlets it had banned. Politico said the exclusion prevented it from carrying out rotating pool duties for other newsrooms.

stories.title: Trump to unveil executive actions aimed at lowering diesel prices
stories.summary: Trump plans to announce executive measures to bring down fuel costs during a Monday campaign stop in Nebraska, after the White House rejected a diesel export ban. High diesel prices have become a political problem for Republicans ahead of the midterms.

stories.title: Is Iran charging a toll to move oil through the Strait of Hormuz?
stories.summary: Middle East oil exports have climbed back above pre-war levels despite Tehran blocking the Strait of Hormuz, and questions are growing over whether Iran now charges ships a fee to transit. The waterway has been effectively closed to most commercial traffic for more than 200 days.

stories.title: US Marine arrested over murder of woman in Okinawa
stories.summary: The III Marine Expeditionary Force confirmed that Lance Cpl. Devin Jacob Ballard, 20, was arrested on suspicion of murdering 39-year-old Anna Yagi at a Naha hotel. The case has renewed Japanese criticism of the US military presence on Okinawa and drew a formal protest from Tokyo.

stories.title: Reflection AI releases Beam, a 501B open-weight model
stories.summary: Reflection AI published Beam, a 501-billion-parameter open-weight model, drawing heavy attention within minutes of release. The launch adds another very large open model to a market dominated by closed frontier systems.

stories.title: OpenAI adds invisible text watermarks to ChatGPT and Codex
stories.summary: OpenAI began rolling out machine-readable textGrain watermarks for eligible ChatGPT and Codex output in the EU to meet AI Act provenance rules, while letting API customers worldwide opt in. The marks are invisible to readers and detection starts with researchers.

stories.title: Pentagon stops using Anthropic AI tools after blacklisting company
stories.summary: A Pentagon official told the BBC that the Department of Defense has ceased using Anthropic products, completing a phase-out ordered in February after the company refused to drop safeguards against autonomous weapons. Anthropic has separately sued the government over being labelled a supply chain risk.

stories.title: AI lab employees explain why they quit OpenAI and Anthropic
stories.summary: New York Magazine interviewed former employees who left leading AI labs over how their work could be used, citing defense contracts and job displacement. The piece captures growing internal dissent across the industry.

stories.title: Browns at Jets early odds: New York a slim home favorite for Week 5
stories.summary: Early lines for Sunday at MetLife Stadium have the Jets favored by about a field goal over Cleveland. The Browns are 3-1 and carry a three-game win streak into the matchup.

stories.title: Browns climb Week 5 power rankings after 3-1 start
stories.summary: Sporting News moved Cleveland up to No. 17 in its Week 5 power rankings, crediting a three-game win streak and a defense adjusting without Myles Garrett. Deshaun Watson has steadied with a young receiving corps around him.

stories.title: Browns jump into top 10 of Week 5 power rankings
stories.summary: Yahoo Sports put Cleveland at No. 10 in its Week 5 rankings, one of the biggest jumps in the league after the Browns beat Pittsburgh 27-24. The team sits at 3-1 with winnable games ahead.

stories.title: Bookmakers still price Browns as long shots despite 3-1 start
stories.summary: Sports Illustrated notes Cleveland moved only to +18000 to win the Super Bowl while shortening to +250 to make the playoffs. Oddsmakers remain skeptical even as the Browns sit at 3-1.

stories.title: Jeremiah Smith wins second straight Big Ten Offensive Player of the Week
stories.summary: Ohio State receiver Jeremiah Smith took the Big Ten weekly offensive honor again after 11 catches for 206 yards and two touchdowns at Iowa. He set program career records for receptions, receiving yards and touchdown catches in the 31-14 win.

stories.title: Ohio State-Indiana rematch set for noon kickoff on FOX
stories.summary: Indiana announced that its Oct. 17 home game against Ohio State will kick at noon ET on FOX, with Big Noon Kickoff expected on site. It is a top-10 rematch of the 2025 Big Ten championship game.

stories.title: Five things to know as Ohio State turns to Maryland
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors previewed Saturday home game against Maryland, noting the Terrapins may be nearing a coaching change and that quarterback Malik Washington can make plays. Ohio State hosts Maryland at 4:15 p.m. ET on Oct. 10.

stories.title: ESPN projects Ohio State in the College Football Playoff after Week 5
stories.summary: ESPN Week 5 bowl and playoff projections slot the Buckeyes as a top-six seed following their road win at Iowa. Both projections have Ohio State playing in a quarterfinal.

stories.title: Verstappen win in Malaysia hints at a close title fight next season
stories.summary: Max Verstappen won in Malaysia and Formula 1 argued the result points to a tighter championship battle in 2027. Red Bull cured weaknesses to hand the Dutchman his first win of 2026.

stories.title: FIA Formula 2 and Formula 3 announce 2027 calendars
stories.summary: The F2 and F3 schedules for 2027 add Istanbul and Mexico City to Formula 2 across 14 rounds. Formula 1 chief Stefano Domenicali called the junior categories the pathway to the top of the sport.

stories.title: Five winners and five losers from the Malaysia Grand Prix
stories.summary: Formula 1 ran through the biggest gains and setbacks from Sunday race at Sepang, where Verstappen won and McLaren left points on the table. The piece weighs strategy calls and driver performances.

stories.title: McLaren got their Sepang tyre strategy sums wrong
stories.summary: Formula 1 detailed how an incorrect judgement on tyre life cost McLaren at the Malaysian Grand Prix. The team misread degradation on a hot Sepang afternoon.

stories.title: Two hospitalized in East Columbus shooting
stories.summary: Columbus police said two people were hospitalized in stable condition after a Sunday afternoon shooting on the East Side. The incident was separate from an early-morning Barnett Road shooting that killed one person.

stories.title: Suspect arrested in Columbus stabbing death after manhunt to Logan
stories.summary: Brandon Parsons died after being stabbed at Cleveland and Reynolds avenues early Sunday, and police filed a murder warrant for Jacob Iams, who was arrested in Logan hours later. Police said the arrest came about 11 hours after the stabbing.

stories.title: Shooting on Columbus East Side kills one, injures one
stories.summary: One person died and another was injured in a shooting late Sunday on the 3600 block of Seabrook Avenue, a Columbus police dispatcher said. The second victim was taken to a hospital in unstable condition.

stories.title: Columbus weather: pleasant Monday before a workweek warm-up
stories.summary: Forecasters called for a comfortable, dry Monday across central Ohio ahead of hotter, more humid air later in the week. Scattered storms are possible Thursday through Saturday.
